description: This Java class defines an immutable implementation of a namespaced entity ID, including validation, factory methods, and standard overrides.

classes.name: DefaultNamespacedEntityId
classes.description: Immutable implementation of NamespacedEntityId supporting validation, creation, and comparison.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a NamespacedEntityId from a CharSequence, returning the same instance if already of type DefaultNamespacedEntityId or NamespacedEntityId.

methods.name: fromName
methods.description: Creates a NamespacedEntityId with default namespace for a given entity name.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new NamespacedEntityId with specified namespace and name.

methods.name: dummy
methods.description: Returns a dummy ID that should not be used.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates namespace and name, throwing exception if invalid.
